data.desc: Exicure, Inc. (Nasdaq: XCUR) has historically been an early-stage biotechnology company focused on developing nucleic acid therapies targeting ribonucleic acid against validated targets. Following its restructuring and the suspension of its clinical and development activities, the Company has been evaluating strategic alternatives to maximize stockholder value. In January 2025, the Company acquired GPCR Therapeutics USA Inc., a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing treatments for blood disorders, whose lead program, GPC-100, has been evaluated for improving stem cell mobilization in multiple myeloma and sickle cell disease and for supporting cell and gene therapy.
